scope: Preserve null LAYER_CONTROL reference slots so source proxy ATTRIBUTE_LAYER indices resolve to their source layer names.

oda.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
oda.rule: §20.4.53 says Numentries counts layer 0 and the handle stream contains a null control handle, the XDictionary owner, then layer object handles. Preserve declared slots independently from the compact ownership-reference list.

implementation.behavior: DRW_ObjControl retains declared wire-order handle slots, including zero references, while handlesList remains a compact set of valid ownership references. The DWG reader builds m_layerNameOrder from LAYER_CONTROL's slot vector and resolves non-null handles through the parsed layer table. Linetype indexing is unchanged because this source has only the BYLAYER sentinel and does not adjudicate linetype null-slot indexing.
implementation.strictOutput: Unchanged: whole-source DWG-to-DXF output still refuses the 36 typed proxy caches.
